description: This file defines the MenuItem entity class for use with Doctrine ORM. It maps to the 'ohrm_menu_item' database table and includes properties such as id, menuTitle, parent, level, orderHint, status, screen, and additionalParams, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents a menu item in the system, including hierarchical relationships, display order, status, associated screen, and additional JSON parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the MenuItem.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the MenuItem.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu item.

methods.name: setMenuTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the menu item.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent MenuItem, if any, for hierarchical structuring.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical level of the menu item.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the hierarchical level of the menu item.

methods.name: getOrderHint
methods.description: Returns the order hint for display ordering.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the menu item is active/enabled.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the associated Screen entity, if any.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Associates a Screen entity with this menu item.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns the additional parameters stored as JSON.
